name: @ndrs92/contracts
description: Shared API contracts for the Veci platform

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -b tsconfig.cjs.json --force && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/cjs', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }, null, 2) + '\n')"
